question: _______, a 500-year-old dance form, is an Indian Classical dance that developed from the Vaishnavite monasteries of Assam.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sattriya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Satriya Nritya is the classical dance form of the North-Eastern State of Assam which represents the Satriya culture, the basis of the religious and cultural fabric of Assam.

 
 
• It is a dance-dram
